description: Suites of Apple-only providers (platform/apple: Objective-C++ over Foundation, UIKit and GameKit) that exist only on iOS and tvOS devices. tools/quality/ios_conformance.py builds and runs them on the device profiles that list this profile in `hosts` (ios-arm64-device, tvos-arm64-device), with the same checks-v1 protocol as the headless suites. The Linux runner cannot build them: it selects them only with --runner apple-device or an explicit selector and reports them unavailable, because each of its rows requires CONFORMANCE_APPLE_DEVICE, which no host sets.
